==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I taught Johnson my method for lucid dreaming. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (When I lucid dream, I cross my arms and grip them with my hands. I also cross my ankles. The way I lie down is similar to that of a mummy. This allows me to feel my body fall asleep and numb out, triggering a state of sleep paralysis that allows me near instant lucidity.)
We both began to dream within the dream, but when we woke up we discovered a new area of the forest.
The new area is highly reactive to thoughts and warps quickly relative to what it's denizens are thinking. (I call this new area of the forest the Lucid Lands. The Lucid Lands don't have a set appearance, because they shift and change rapidly relative to what its denizens are thinking.)
